title: CaseManifest
description: Contract 2 (artifact), catalog row case-manifest 1.1.1: the authoritative record of one baked crushing case, written by data-pipeline/pipeline/core/manifest.py build_case_manifest to data/derived/manifests/<case>.json. A pure function of (params, seed): no wall-clock time. Rules the schema cannot state, checked by scripts/check_artifacts.py and the producer test: artifact.bytes equals the size of the file at artifact.path; lane equals gate.lane; measured is present exactly when real_or_synthetic is real; every metric named in expect is a key of metrics and lies inside its range.

case_id.description: The case identifier, for example S01 or HP500-01.

title.description: The case title in English and Spanish.

category.description: The case category in English and Spanish.

stage.description: The circuit stage the case belongs to.

control.description: For a control case, what it controls; null otherwise.

real_or_synthetic.description: real: one of the measured HP500 surveys; synthetic: a circuit case of the engine.

expected_band.description: What a crushing engineer should see, in words; expect states the same in numbers.

context.description: The case write-up shown in the workbench Context: the question, the variables that matter and how to read the views.

variables.description: The variables that matter for it.

reading.description: How to read the views on it.

package.description: The Python package of the canonical engine.

version.description: The product version of the engine.

model.description: The models the engine chains, in words, with the HP500 calibration named on a calibrated case.

engine.description: The engine that baked the case.

params.description: The operating point the case was baked at (contract 1 accepted it); calibrated is true only on the HP500 surveys.

machine.description: The crusher kind; the engine's per-machine constants follow it.

css_mm.description: Closed-side setting, the narrowest gap between the mantle and the concave (or the jaws) [mm].

throw_mm.description: Eccentric throw, the open-side setting minus the closed-side setting [mm].

feed_x63_mm.description: Rosin-Rammler characteristic size of the feed (63.2 percent passing) [mm].

feed_m.description: Rosin-Rammler uniformity exponent of the feed, dimensionless.

ore_axb.description: JKMRC drop-weight ore competence A times b, dimensionless; lower is harder.

ore_wi.description: Bond work index of the ore [kWh/t].

calibrated.description: True only on the HP500 surveys, whose engine runs with the calibration of Rocha et al. 2024.

measured.description: Only on a real case: the survey row exactly as contract hp500-survey accepted it.

power_kw.description: Crusher power estimated from the measured current [kW].

seed.description: The seed the case was baked with; the manifest is a pure function of the operating point and this seed.

path.description: Relative to data/derived; no leading slash, no '..', no backslash.

trace_schema.description: The schema identifier of the trace, chancadem.trace/v1.

bytes.description: The size of the trace file as committed [bytes].

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the trace file bytes as committed.

lane.description: How the App serves the case: live (the engine may run it in the browser) or precompute (the App replays the committed trace).
The lane the measurement assigns, the same as lane.

pure_python.description: Whether the engine is pure Python.

wheels.description: The compiled packages the engine depends on; a live case may use only numpy.

run_ms_budget.description: The time one engine run may take for a live case, 1500 ms [ms].

trace_bytes_budget.description: The largest trace a live case may have, 262,144 bytes [bytes].

reasons.description: Why the case is not live; empty for a live case.

gate.description: The measured lane verdict of data-pipeline/pipeline/core/gate.py classify_lane: the engine run is timed in the bake (the median of several warmed runs) and judged against run_ms_budget, but the measured time is not stored, so the manifest stays a pure function of (params, seed).

flags.description: Stable codes of the engine's flags and envelope codes for this case, in the engine's order: css_ge_feed_top (nothing is gripped), pass_through (CSS at or above F80), negligible_reduction (reduction ratio near 1), ill_conditioned (the solve's conditioning guard), the envelope codes css_nonpositive, feed_nonpositive, f80_lt_css, css_outside_calibrated, f80_outside_calibrated, and two sourced warnings that never make a case invalid: css_below_vendor_minimum (the setting is below the vendor minimum of the machine type) and reduction_ratio_above_typical (F80/P80 is above the typical ceiling of one stage). The web maps each code to its bilingual text.

metrics.description: The case's result scalars (p80_mm, p50_mm, p20_mm and f80_mm in mm, reduction_ratio, throughput_tph in t/h, power_kw in kW, specific_energy_kwh_t in kWh/t) and, on a real case, the model error against the survey (throughput_err_pct and power_err_pct, in percent).

models.description: Per model slot (catalog row id), what answers in this bake: the released ONNX model (real) or the slot's baseline.

expect.description: The checked expectation of the case: [low, high] per result metric; the bake fails outside it.

source.description: Where the case comes from: the authored circuit matrix, or the publication of a measured survey.

kind.description: authored: a case of the circuit matrix.

citation.description: The publication the survey is transcribed from.

license.description: The licence of the published data.

text.description: Every reader-facing string is bilingual at the source.
